notes: A file manager for the device's own storage. Pin and version from the build installed from Play on the F21 Pro (1.9291, versionCode 1593359), signed with Play App Signing (CN=Android, O=Google Inc.). No network on purpose: browsing, opening, moving and cleaning up files all work offline, and what the network adds (cloud backup, cleaning suggestions) is not needed. It holds REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES and can open an APK it finds on the storage; whether that installs is decided by the install restrictions on the device, not by this entry. Nearby Share goes over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, which the Bluetooth sharing restriction governs.
